title: नेपालभाषा शिक्षाया इतिहास
nepali: आधुनिक शिक्षाया संस्थागत व्यवस्था न्हेव नेपालय्‌ नं भारतय्‌ छेलाबुलाय्‌ दुगु वैदिक वा संस्कृत शिक्षा व वौद्ध शिक्षा परम्परा निगूकथंया शिक्षा छेलाबुलाय्‌ वयाच्वंगु ख:। किरातकालया शिक्षावारे एकिन याय्‌फूगु मदु । मल्लकालय्‌ मल्ल जुजुपिन्सं जनतायात शिक्षा बीमा: थेँ मताय्‌कू । शाहकालया पूर्वार्द्धय्‌ सर्वसाधारणया नितिं स्कूल चाय्‌कुगु खनेमदु । दरवारय्‌ राजगुरु तया: ब्वँकीगु ख:सा मेपिं गुरुया छेँय्‌ वना: ब्वनीगु ख:। आधुनिक शिक्षाया प्रारम्भ विसं १९१० सालं दरवार हाईस्कूलं जुल । नेपालभाषा शिक्षाया प्रारम्भ महावीर स्कूल व नेपाल राष्ट्रिय विद्यापिठं जूगु खनेदु । थौंकन्हय्‌ वया: पूर्व प्राथमिक तगिंनिसे पीएचडीतक नं नेपालभाषां याय्‌गु व्यवस्था दु । थुगु च्वसुया उद्देश्य नेपालय्‌ नेपालभाषा औपचारिक शिक्षा गुबलेनिसें न्ह्यात धइगु मालेगु ख:। च्वसूलिसे स्वाःगु पुस्तकालयया सामग्री छेलागु दु । पूर्वीय भाषाकथं माध्यामिक तगिमय्‌ नेसं १०७१ निसें नेपालभाषा ब्वने दुगु खः। आइ.ए.तगिमय्‌ नेसं १०८० निसें नेपालभाषा ब्वनेदत । १०९७ निसें डिग्री बाइ डिजर्टेशन याय्‌गु ब्यवस्था जुल । थुकथं राणाकालंनिसें नेपालभाषायात प्रजातन्त्र वय्‌धुंका: तक नं सरकारं नेपालभाषायात कोतेलेगु हे नीति का:गु खनेदु ।
american_english: Prior to institutional arrangements for modern education, two types of educational traditions that were in practice in India—Vedic or Sanskrit education and Buddhist education—were in practice in Nepal as well. Nothing can be ascertained with certainty regarding education during the Kirat period. During the Malla period, the Malla kings did not seem to consider it necessary to provide education to the public. In the first half of the Shah period, no schools were seen to have been opened for the general public. In the palace, instruction was provided by retaining a royal preceptor, whereas others studied by going to the homes of gurus. The beginning of modern education occurred in VS 1910 with Durbar High School. The inception of Nepal Bhasa education is seen to have commenced from Mahavir School and Nepal Rashtriya Vidyapeeth. Coming to the present day, arrangements exist to pursue education in Nepal Bhasa from the pre-primary level up to PhD. The purpose of this article is to explore when formal Nepal Bhasa education began in Nepal. Library materials related to the article have been utilized. As an Oriental language, Nepal Bhasa could be studied at the secondary level from NS 1071. At the I.A. level, it became possible to study Nepal Bhasa from NS 1080. From 1097, provisions were made for Degree by Dissertation. In this manner, from the Rana period up to even after the advent of democracy, the government is seen to have adopted a policy of suppressing Nepal Bhasa.

australian_english: Before institutional arrangements for modern education were set up, two kinds of educational traditions that were practiced in India—Vedic or Sanskrit education and Buddhist education—were practiced in Nepal as well. Nothing can be established with certainty regarding education during the Kirat period. During the Malla period, the Malla kings did not seem to reckon it necessary to provide education to the public. In the first half of the Shah period, no schools appear to have been opened for ordinary people. In the palace, classes were given by engaging a royal guru, while others studied by going round to the homes of gurus. The start of modern education took place in VS 1910 with Durbar High School. The start of Nepal Bhasa education is seen to have emerged from Mahavir School and Nepal Rashtriya Vidyapeeth. Nowadays, arrangements are in place to study in Nepal Bhasa from pre-primary level right up to PhD. The aim of this article is to find out when formal Nepal Bhasa education kicked off in Nepal. Library materials relevant to the article have been used. As an Oriental language, Nepal Bhasa could be studied at the secondary level from NS 1071. At the I.A. level, studying Nepal Bhasa became possible from NS 1080. From 1097, arrangements were introduced for Degree by Dissertation. In this way, from the Rana era right up until after democracy arrived, the government appears to have stuck to a policy of keeping Nepal Bhasa down.
informal_english: Before any proper institutional setup for modern education came along, two types of schooling traditions on the go in India—Vedic or Sanskrit schooling and Buddhist schooling—were in practice over in Nepal too. You can't say anything for certain about schooling back in the Kirat period, to be sure. During the Malla times, the Malla kings didn't seem to think it was at all necessary to give schooling to the ordinary folk. In the first half of the Shah period, you wouldn't see a single school opened up for the common crowd. In the palace, they had a royal guru brought in to do the teaching, while the rest went off to the gurus' houses to get their learning. The whole modern education lark got going in VS 1910 with Durbar High School. As for Nepal Bhasa schooling, that seems to have kicked off from Mahavir School and Nepal Rashtriya Vidyapeeth. Nowadays, mind you, there are arrangements to do your studies in Nepal Bhasa all the way from pre-primary right up to a PhD. The whole point of this article is to suss out when formal Nepal Bhasa education actually got started in Nepal. Relevant library materials were pulled together and used for the piece. As an Oriental language, you could study Nepal Bhasa at secondary level from NS 1071 onwards. At the I.A. level, you could finally take up Nepal Bhasa from NS 1080. From 1097, they sorted out an option to do a Degree by Dissertation. So from the Rana days right through to after democracy landed, it looks like the government stuck firmly to a policy of suppressing Nepal Bhasa.
